anomalies.observed: Both isolated CAN transceivers have their isolated-side ground pins GND2 (pins 5) and their logic-side GND1 (pins 4) on the main GND net. The isolated-side supply VCC2 (pin 8) is on 5V_switched_CAN, and no isolated ground net exists on the motherboard.
anomalies.expected: The isolated-side ground (GND2) of an isolated CAN transceiver should be on a separate isolated ground, not on the board's main GND. Tying it to GND defeats the galvanic isolation that the spec describes for the two CAN buses.

evidence.quote: GND [High Power] : ... U10.4(GND1,power_in) U10.5(GND2,power_in) U11.4(GND1,power_in) U11.5(GND2,power_in)
5V_switched_CAN : C15.2(2,passive) C16.2(2,passive) J13.7(Pin_7,passive) J2.7(Pin_7,passive) JP8.2(B,passive) Q9.3(D,passive) U10.8(VCC2,power_in) U11.8(VCC2,power_in)
two isolated CAN buses (`CAN0`, `CAN1`), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (`U8`, `U9`) through an isolated CAN transceiver (`U11`/companion)

anomalies.impact: The CAN bus is not actually isolated from the motherboard ground. Ground loops and common-mode faults from the motor-controller side can flow into the CM4 carrier, which defeats the protection the isolated transceivers are meant to provide.

anomalies.observed: The anodes of the three Ethernet/PI status LEDs (D4, D14, D23) sit on net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW. This net has no other connection, so no supply or driver feeds it. The other LED supply net, /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV, is driven by U34.Y.
anomalies.expected: Status LED anodes should be fed from a 3.3V rail (for example +3V3, or a switched 3.3V source that actually exists on the board) so the LEDs can light.

evidence.quote: /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV : D28.2(A,passive) D29.2(A,passive) D30.3(A1,input) D8.2(A,passive) Q10.1(G,input) R58.2(2,passive) U34.4(Y,output) U7.5(OE,input)

anomalies.impact: The Ethernet link/activity LEDs and the PI activity LED have no power path and will stay dark, so the operator loses the status indication they are meant to give.

parsed.summary: The netlist and SPICE deck agree on values and most connectivity, and no clear shorts or wrong values were found. The two CAN transceivers' isolated grounds are tied to the main GND, which defeats the stated isolation, and three status-LED anodes sit on a net with no supply, so I report these with moderate-to-low confidence.
